reason: The plugin is primarily an execution-trajectory visualization tool: it adds a Graph/图谱 tab in DeepSeek Harness and projects the session’s structured turn-by-turn execution snapshot into an interactive DAG-like interface with node inspection and viewport controls. Its direct user-facing purpose is viewing and understanding AI execution flow rather than modifying models, tools, or external workflows.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在会话界面新增“Graph/图谱”视图，将执行轨迹按回合以可交互图形方式展示，并支持搜索筛选、展开收起与节点详情查看。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a Graph view to display per-turn trajectory execution as an interactive visualization, including search/filter controls, collapse behavior, zoom/pan navigation, and node detail inspection.

capabilities: Render trajectory snapshots as an interactive graph inside the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Navigate session and per-turn execution history with search/filter/collapse controls
Pan/zoom/fit graph viewport and inspect node-level execution details
Provide live updates to the graph view during active sessions

reasons.code: Reads existing trajectory data from active sessions to build graph views, so runtime execution information is displayed in the interface.
Integrates with DeepSeek Harness web host through DSH client/runtime/ui-trajectory packages and a cordis patch entry, indicating in-browser extension of product UI behavior.
Includes features for node inspection (payload/result/schema/timing) and large-session navigation, which can expose sensitive operational details if available in session data.
